note: STRICT-005 enforce resources, recorded in the declared Linux environment. Limits belong to the action, not the worker: the child applies RLIMIT_NPROC and RLIMIT_AS from the plan with raw syscalls immediately before exec, because applying them in the worker also constrained the worker's own fork. The probe asks for 8 GiB and touches a page per megabyte so the allocation cannot be optimised into an unreserved mapping; the case passes when the declared limit refuses it. The process namespace is asserted in the same case, since a limit is only observable when the action cannot see the host's processes. Fault proof: dropping the two setrlimit calls makes the allocation succeed and the case fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
